text: Saunders FICTION CivilWarLand in Bad Decline Pastoralia The Very Persistent Gappers of Frip The Brief and Frightening Reign of Phil In Persuasion Nation ESSAYS The Braindead Megaphone ABOUT THE AUTHOR George Saunders is the author of six previous books, including the story collections CivilWarLand in Bad Decline , Pastoralia , and In Persuasion Nation . He has received fellowships from the Lannan Foundation, the American Academy of Arts and Letters, and the Guggenheim Foundation. In 2006 he was awarded a MacArthur Fellowship. He teaches in the Creative Writing Program at Syracuse University.
